name: braintrust
summary: I successfully installed the Braintrust SDK (`braintrust` and `autoevals`) and created the `tutorial_eval.py` quickstart file. The eval demonstrably runs locally: executing `braintrust eval tutorial_eval.py --no-send-logs` produced real output showing `Say Hi Bot (tasks): 100%|██████████| 2/2` and a final score of `77.78% 'Levenshtein' score`. However, network connectivity to the Braintrust API is blocked in this sandbox—every HTTPS request to `braintrust.dev` or `www.braintrust.dev` fails with a TLS handshake `Connection reset by peer` error, so the eval run cannot be uploaded to the platform and verified remotely.

env_ready.evidence: Defaulting to user installation because normal site-packages is not writeable

friction.detail: Agent tried multiple guessed URLs like https://www.braintrust.dev/docs/start/eval before falling back to GitHub raw README
OpenSSL SSL_connect: Connection reset by peer in connection to braintrust.dev:443

friction.where: Eval CLI default behavior without network
friction.detail: Traceback on first run; had to add --no-send-logs (not in quickstart) to avoid upload crash
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" required before braintrust CLI was found
